gulpereel: A gulper eel, a deep-sea fish that is almost entirely MOUTH: an ENORMOUS loose black pouch of a jaw far wider and deeper than the whole rest of the animal, hinged right at the back of the head, tapering behind into a whip-thin body no thicker than a pencil that trails away to a fine point. Tiny pinprick eyes set right at the front of the snout.
commonfangtooth: A common fangtooth, a SHORT DEEP-BODIED blackish-brown fish THE SIZE OF A HUMAN FIST, not a large fish. Its head is enormous for its body, roughly a third of its whole length, with a steep blunt forehead, deep pits and ridges across the skull, small dull eyes, and a wide gaping jaw carrying a few ENORMOUS CURVED NEEDLE TEETH, the two lower ones so long they rise past its face.
viperfish: A viperfish, a slender iridescent blue-black fish with a long low body and a large head. Its lower fangs are SO LONG THEY CLOSE OUTSIDE ITS FACE, curving up past its eyes rather than fitting inside the mouth. The first ray of its back fin is drawn out into a long whip standing far above its head, tipped with a small pale bead. Rows of tiny pale dots run in lines along its flanks.
macropinnabarreleye: A barreleye fish, a small dark fish whose entire forehead is a TRANSPARENT DOME OF CLEAR FLESH like a fluid-filled windscreen, through which TWO BRIGHT EMERALD-GREEN TUBULAR EYES are visible INSIDE the head, pointing straight upward. Two small dark hollows sit low above its mouth. Broad flat side fins held out level, body dark and blunt. A living fish, absolutely NOT a wooden barrel.
silverhatchetfish: A hatchetfish, a tiny fish with a body FLATTENED SIDE TO SIDE AS THIN AS A COIN and DEEP AND KEELED BELOW like the blade of an axe-head, tapering back to a narrow tail stalk. Brilliant mirror-silver flanks, an upturned mouth, and LARGE ROUND EYES AIMED UPWARD. A neat row of small pale light-organs runs along its lower keel. A living fish, absolutely NOT a metal hatchet or tool.
blackdragonfish: A black dragonfish, a very long slender jet-black fish shaped like a ribbon, of even depth along its whole length with tiny fins and no thick body. A SINGLE LONG THIN BARBEL hangs beneath its chin, longer than its own head, ending in a small pale bulb. Rows of fine pale dots line its underside. A fish, absolutely NOT a dragon: no wings, no legs, no armour plates.
glacierlanternfish: A lanternfish, a SMALL slender fish about the length of a finger with a blunt rounded head, very large round eyes, and a deeply forked tail. Dark blue-black along the back and brilliant mirror-silver on the flanks, with NEAT ROWS OF SMALL ROUND PEARL-LIKE LIGHT ORGANS set into its belly and lower sides like studs. A living fish, absolutely NOT a lamp or a lantern.
marianasnailfish: A Mariana snailfish, a small TADPOLE-SHAPED fish: a bulbous rounded head and body tapering into a flattened tail edged all the way round with a thin transparent fringe of fin. Its skin is PALE TRANSLUCENT PINKISH-WHITE and completely smooth, the faint shadow of the body showing through it, and it has tiny dark dot eyes. A fish, absolutely NOT a snail: no shell of any kind.
tripodfish: A tripod fish, a slim brown fish held up on THREE IMMENSELY LONG STIFF FIN RAYS, one from the tail and one from each hip, each ray several times longer than the fish's own body and as thin as wire, propping it up like stilts. Its two front fins are held out and forward like raised antennae. A living fish, absolutely NOT a camera tripod or a stand.
cookiecuttershark: A cookiecutter shark, a SMALL CIGAR-SHAPED shark about the length of a forearm, with a short blunt rounded snout, large round green eyes set well forward, and small fins placed far back near the tail. Its underside is pale and luminous except for a DARK BAND LIKE A COLLAR around its throat. Its mouth is small and round with thick fleshy sucking lips. A living shark, absolutely NOT a biscuit or a cutter.
blobfish: A blobfish AS IT LOOKS AT DEPTH, where it is an ORDINARY WELL-FORMED FISH: a stout pinkish-grey fish with a large blunt head, a wide down-turned mouth, big dark eyes, loose soft skin, and broad rounded fins held out from the body. Its shape is firm and fish-like, propped on its lower fins.
australiancoffinfish: An Australian coffinfish, a ROUND BALLOON-SHAPED anglerfish, very nearly spherical, its deep pinkish-red skin covered in short prickly spines. It rests on two pairs of THICK FLESHY FINS THAT WORK LIKE STUBBY LEGS. A very short thin stalk rises from just above its mouth, tipped with a small pale tuft, and huge gill openings slit the sides behind the fins. A living fish, absolutely NOT a coffin or a box.
stoplightloosejaw: A stoplight loosejaw, a slender black fish with a very large head, whose LOWER JAW IS A BARE OPEN FRAMEWORK OF TWO THIN CURVED BONES with no skin or floor between them, so the view passes straight through the jaw. A LARGE ROUND DEEP-RED LIGHT ORGAN sits directly beneath each eye with a smaller green one behind it. A living fish, absolutely NOT a traffic light or a signal.
deepsealizardfish: A deep-sea lizardfish, a slim rigid pale grey-brown fish with a LONG FLATTENED WEDGE-SHAPED HEAD and a very wide mouth running back past its eyes, lined with many fine BACKWARD-HINGED BRISTLE TEETH that show even when it is closed. A long low fin runs along its back and it props itself up on two stiff pointed pelvic fins. A fish, absolutely NOT a reptile: no legs, no clawed feet.
vampiresquid: A vampire squid, a soft plum-red animal shaped like a rounded bell, whose eight arms are joined along their length by ONE CONTINUOUS SHEET OF DARK SKIN so they open like an umbrella and close into a smooth cloak. The inner face of that sheet carries rows of soft fleshy spines. TWO VERY LARGE ROUND PALE-BLUE EYES, enormous for its size, and two small rounded fins on its mantle. Absolutely NOT a vampire and NOT a cape of cloth.
googlyeyedglasssquid: A glass squid, a squid whose body is a TRANSPARENT ROUNDED FLASK of clear jelly, so see-through that only its internal organs read as a small dark packet low inside it. TWO ENORMOUS ROUND EYES sit at the front, far too large for the body, and eight short arms with two longer tentacles gather below. A living animal, absolutely NOT made of glass and NOT an ornament.
bigfinsquid: A bigfin squid, a small pale translucent squid with TWO VERY LARGE ROUNDED FINS at the top of its body, together wider than the body itself. Its arms are the point: all ten are held out STRAIGHT AND STIFF, then bend at a SHARP RIGHT-ANGLE ELBOW near the base and trail away downward as FINE THREADS MANY TIMES THE LENGTH OF THE ENTIRE BODY, hair-thin and slightly wavy.
dumbooctopus: A dumbo octopus, a small soft pale-pink octopus shaped like a rounded bell, with TWO SMALL ROUNDED FIN FLAPS STICKING OUT ONE ON EACH SIDE OF ITS HEAD above the eyes. Its eight short arms are joined for most of their length by a SHEET OF SKIN forming a smooth open umbrella, so the whole animal reads as a soft parachute. Absolutely NOT an elephant.
giantisopod: A giant isopod, an armoured crustacean shaped exactly like a woodlouse BUT THE SIZE OF A DOMESTIC CAT: a pale creamy-lilac segmented shell of overlapping curved plates, a broad shield over the head, two pairs of long jointed antennae, LARGE FIXED COMPOUND EYES set wide apart, and many pairs of pointed legs beneath. Its tail plates fan out behind.
hoffcrab: A Hoff crab, a pale bone-white squat crab whose UNDERSIDE AND THE INNER FACES OF ITS CLAWS AND LEGS ARE COVERED IN DENSE MATS OF FINE PALE BRISTLES like a thick coat of hair. Its shell is smooth and rounded, its claws short and stout, and its face is a smooth blank plate. A crab, absolutely NOT a yeti and NOT any furry humanoid.
giantamphipod: A giant amphipod, a pale cream crustacean shaped like a sand-hopper BUT AS LONG AS A HUMAN FOREARM: a body curved into a shallow C and flattened side to side, built of many neat overlapping segments, two pairs of antennae at the front, small dark eyes, and rows of slender legs beneath, the front pairs ending in small hooked pincers.
eyelessventshrimp: A vent shrimp, a stout pale shrimp whose head is a SMOOTH UNBROKEN SHIELD, entirely featureless across the front, and which carries A LARGE PALE OVAL PATCH ON ITS BACK just behind the head, showing faintly through the semi-transparent white shell. Its body is shrimp-shaped and slightly hunched, with short antennae and many fine legs beneath.
gianttubeworm: A giant tube worm, a tall white leathery tube standing straight upright, taller than a person, from the open top of which emerges a DENSE PLUME OF DEEP SCARLET-RED FEATHERY GILLS like a brush of fine blood-red filaments. The tube itself is smooth, chalky white and faintly ringed along its length. Nothing else protrudes from it.
zombieworm: A zombie worm, a TINY soft animal only a few centimetres long: a slender pale pink trunk topped by a CROWN OF FOUR OR FIVE FEATHERY PLUMES in pink and red waving loose like small ostrich feathers, and at the other end a mass of PALE GREEN ROOTS that divide and re-divide, spreading out flat. A small soft worm, absolutely NOT a zombie and NOT anything undead.
munidopsissquatlobster: A squat lobster, a small pale crustacean that reads like a lobster FLATTENED FROM ABOVE with its tail TUCKED TIGHTLY UNDER ITS BODY out of sight, so it looks like a broad flat crab with long arms. Its two claws are SLENDER AND MUCH LONGER THAN ITS WHOLE BODY, held out in front, and its creamy-white shell is ridged and bristly with fine spines.
neolepasventbarnacle: A stalked barnacle, an animal built of two parts: a THICK FLESHY MUSCULAR STALK like a short pale neck, and at its top a HEAD OF SMOOTH WHITE OVERLAPPING CHALKY PLATES closed into a rounded shell. From a slit between those plates a FAN OF FINE CURLED FEATHERY LEGS reaches out and sweeps. A single animal alone, only one in the frame.
giantsiphonophore: A giant siphonophore, a COLONY THAT LOOKS LIKE ONE ANIMAL: an extremely long fine transparent string many times longer than a person is tall, drifting in slow curves. At the leading end sits a compact cluster of small clear pulsing bells; behind it the string carries HUNDREDS OF REPEATING IDENTICAL UNITS in neat rows, tiny bells and small feeding sacs and fine trailing threads, all alike, all the way down.
alarmjellyfish: An Atolla jellyfish, a DEEP BLOOD-RED jellyfish with a domed bell whose rim is cut into a ring of EVENLY SPACED POINTED SCALLOPS, with a deep groove running right around the bell just above them. Short fine tentacles trail from each scallop, and ONE SINGLE TENTACLE IS ENORMOUSLY LONGER THAN ALL THE OTHERS, streaming far away from the animal.
bloodybellycombjelly: A bloody-belly comb jelly, an oval transparent jelly-bodied animal whose INNER STOMACH IS A DEEP OPAQUE BLOOD-RED SAC clearly visible suspended inside the clear outer body. EIGHT NEAT ROWS OF FINE COMB-PLATES run from top to bottom down the outside, each row shimmering with a travelling band of rainbow colour. A living animal, absolutely NOT gore and NOT blood.
deepstaria: A Deepstaria jellyfish, an enormous THIN LOOSE MEMBRANOUS BELL like a vast sheet of pale translucent silk, held wide open and folding softly over on itself, with almost nothing trailing beneath it. Its whole surface is covered by a fine NET-LIKE PATTERN OF PALE CHANNELS dividing it into polygons like cracked glaze. A living animal, absolutely NOT a plastic bag and NOT cloth.
venussgirdle: A Venus's girdle, a comb jelly shaped like a LONG TRANSPARENT RIBBON as long as a person's outstretched arms but only as wide as two fingers, flattened flat and rippling in slow waves along its length. Almost invisibly clear, with FINE ROWS OF COMB-PLATES running the full length of both long edges, flickering with bands of rainbow colour. A living animal, absolutely NOT a belt and NOT a garment.
helmetjellyfish: A helmet jellyfish, a DEEP RED-BROWN jellyfish whose bell is a TALL POINTED CONE, far taller than it is wide, rising to a rounded peak like a thimble. A dark opaque stomach shows through the middle of the cone, and a ring of about a dozen stiff tentacles of unequal length spreads from its lower rim. A living animal, absolutely NOT a metal helmet.
seapig: A sea pig, a SEA CUCUMBER: a plump translucent pale pink barrel-shaped body about the size of a fist, held up on FIVE OR SIX PAIRS OF LONG STOUT WATER-FILLED TUBE FEET like stilts, with finer tube feet raised from its back like antennae, and a ring of short feeding tentacles at the front end. A soft-bodied sea cucumber, absolutely NOT a pig and NOT a mammal: no snout, no hair, no jointed legs.
venusflowerbasket: A Venus flower basket, a GLASS SPONGE: a slender gently curved TUBE about the length of a forearm standing upright, built entirely of fused white glassy fibres in an INTRICATE REGULAR LATTICE like fine woven mesh, hollow and open at the top, with a ruff of loose glass fibres at the base. A living sponge, absolutely NOT a wicker basket and NOT a flower.
japanesesealily: A Japanese sea lily, an ANIMAL related to starfish that merely looks like a plant: a long slender jointed STALK of stacked disc-shaped segments, topped by a small CUP FROM WHICH TEN FEATHERY ARMS SPREAD AND CURL UPWARD AND OUTWARD, each arm lined along both sides with fine side-filaments like a bird's feather. Creamy white and pale orange. An animal, absolutely NOT a flower and NOT a plant.
leiopathesblackcoral: A black coral colony, an animal colony that divides and re-divides into many fine slender arms like a small bare tree, its skeleton dark brown-black and its entire surface studded with TINY PALE ORANGE-WHITE POLYPS, each a minute ring of six short tentacles, so the whole shape reads as softly furred. A colony of animals, absolutely NOT a plant.
giantxenophyophore: A giant xenophyophore, a SINGLE-CELLED ORGANISM the size of a saucer, shaped like a fragile crumpled rosette of thin overlapping plates and folds, built out of cemented sand grains so its surface is dull, grainy and drab grey-fawn like wadded paper. It has no limbs and no symmetry, only folded layers.
bathydevius: A Bathydevius, a transparent gelatinous swimming sea slug: a clear jelly-like body carrying a LARGE BILLOWING HOOD flared wide open at the front like a loose scoop, a smaller flat paddle-shaped tail at the back, and a small packet of coloured internal organs visible in the middle. Fine finger-like projections line both its sides.
predatorytunicate: A predatory tunicate, a sessile animal that is mostly MOUTH: a smooth translucent pale trumpet-shaped body opening into a HUGE GAPING HOOD held wide like a scoop, far larger than the rest of the body, with a smooth inner surface and a small tube behind it. It stands on a short thick stalk. An animal, absolutely NOT a human figure and NOT a plant: no arms, no legs, no face.
isidellabamboocoral: A bamboo coral colony, an animal colony whose skeleton is built of ALTERNATING SEGMENTS, long chalky WHITE sections separated by short DARK BROWN-BLACK joints repeating all the way up so the stem is banded like a cane. It divides into a few slender arms, and fine pale polyps stud its surface. A colony of animals, absolutely NOT a bamboo plant and NOT wood.
ventmussel: A vent mussel, a large mussel with a smooth ELONGATED WEDGE-SHAPED SHELL about the length of a hand, tapering to a point at the hinge end and broadly rounded at the other, coloured pale tan and brown with fine concentric growth lines. Its shell gapes slightly open, showing a soft cream mantle edge and a pale muscular foot.
bluntnosesixgillshark: A bluntnose sixgill shark, a heavy thick-bodied shark with a BROAD FLATTENED BLUNTLY ROUNDED SNOUT, small vivid GREEN EYES, and SIX LONG GILL SLITS along each side of its throat where most sharks have five. It has ONE SMALL BACK FIN SET VERY FAR BACK near the tail, a long sweeping upper tail lobe, and a comb of low sawlike teeth in the lower jaw.
orangeroughy: An orange roughy, a DEEP-BODIED BRICK-RED-ORANGE fish whose large blunt head takes up a third of its length, with LARGE ROUND DARK EYES and a bony head surface grooved into deep MUCUS CANALS separated by hard ridges. Its mouth is large and set at a slant, its scales are rough and coarse, and a row of small spines runs along its belly.
